audit.why: 7/10 difficulty and the Level 1 Trundle / Level 3-5 Akali / Level 6 Trundle / items Akali shape all match the kits: Chomp out-trades a level-1 Akali, her shroud plus Shuriken Flip owns 3-5, Subjugate flips 6, and her AP items out-scale a Trinity Force Trundle.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 3 spike is built on 'Three-Talon Strike', which is not an Akali ability — it is a pre-rework name. Her real level-3 spike is Five Point Strike plus Shuriken Flip alongside Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon lists Assassin's Mark (P), Five Point Strike (Q), Twilight Shroud (W), Shuriken Flip (E), Perfect Execution (R). No 'Three-Talon Strike' exists.
audit.corrected: Replaced every 'Three-Talon Strike' with the real Q-into-E pattern and anchored the spike to Chomp's 3.5s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) Chomp is described three times as stealing ATTACK SPEED — it saps Attack Damage. (b) wants.foe[0] claims Twilight Shroud dodges 'your targeted Subjugate cast and Pillar placement'. Pillar of Ice is cast at a target LOCATION, not a unit, so shroud does not blank it; Frozen Domain is likewise a ground zone. Only Chomp (300, targeted) and Subjugate (650, targeted) actually fizzle.
audit.why: Riot's Chomp text: 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.' Riot's Twilight Shroud text: she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — a targeting restriction, which ground-cast spells ignore. Riot's Pillar of Ice text: 'creates an ice pillar at target location'. Also unrecorded: Shuriken Flip marks 'the first enemy or smoke cloud hit', so she can flip back into her own shroud — that is the re-entry to deny with the pillar.
audit.corrected: Chomp now saps Attack Damage everywhere; the shroud line now separates targeted casts (Chomp, Subjugate — dead) from ground casts (Pillar, Frozen Domain — still land); added the smoke-cloud E mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gives no numbers for the one ability the whole matchup is gated on.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 and Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 — with both down she has no disengage and Chomp's 3.5s cooldown lets you re-bite twice inside the window.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries 20s shroud and 16s flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded about the unverifiable claim 'wait the full 5-second duration' for Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: The shroud's duration is not in Riot's Data Dragon text and I could not verify it locally, so a hard number should not be asserted.
audit.corrected: Replaced the hard 5-second figure with 'let it expire'.

edits.before: Chomp's AS steal hits before she can activate Twilight Shroud — trade immediately on minion wave contact and collect the heal from any dying minion.
edits.after: Chomp saps her Attack Damage before Twilight Shroud exists — trade on the first minion contact and collect King's Tribute off any dying minion.

edits.before: Akali's Three-Talon Strike combo and Twilight Shroud come fully online — she can trade, vanish, and burst you before you can land a second Chomp.
edits.after: Five Point Strike, Shuriken Flip and Twilight Shroud all land at once — she can poke, vanish and flip back in before your 3.5s Chomp returns.

edits.before: Land Chomp immediately at Level 1 before she activates Twilight Shroud to stack the AS steal and trigger King's Tribute healing
edits.after: Land Chomp at Level 1 before Twilight Shroud exists — it saps her Attack Damage and every dying minion feeds King's Tribute

edits.before: Use Pillar of Ice reactively on her E dash landing spot rather than throwing it blindly into Twilight Shroud
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is ground-cast, so shroud cannot blank it — drop it on her Shuriken Flip landing spot, not on the smoke

edits.before: Activate Twilight Shroud to go invisible and dodge your targeted Subjugate cast and Pillar placement
edits.after: Sit in Twilight Shroud unselectable so your targeted Chomp and Subjugate simply refuse to cast on her

edits.before: Chomp's attack-speed steal lands before she can activate Twilight Shroud at Level 1 — you win the very first auto trade.
edits.after: Chomp saps her Attack Damage and lands before Twilight Shroud exists at Level 1 — you win the very first auto trade.

edits.before: Three-Talon Strike plus a full shroud rotation gives her a burst combo that out-damages your raw Chomp trade in a short window — she owns the initiative.
edits.after: Five Point Strike into Shuriken Flip plus a shroud rotation out-damages your raw Chomp trade in a short window — she owns the initiative from 3.

edits.before: Level 1 is your only clean window: hit Chomp the moment minions meet, steal her attack speed, and collect King's Tribute healing off every dying minion — she cannot Twilight Shroud yet and the AS steal makes her auto-trade miserable. At Level 2 she gains the shroud and the lane flips into a read: if she pops Twilight Shroud to dodge your Q, back off and wait the full 5-second duration rather than walking into the invisible zone swinging blind. By Level 3 her Three-Talon Strike burst lands fast enough that a single misstep inside the shroud becomes a full bar of HP lost — respect the combo, Pillar only when you can see her walking out of the shroud cloud, and accept that you are now the one who has to play around her cooldowns.
edits.after: Level 1 is your only clean window: hit Chomp the moment minions meet, sap her Attack Damage, and collect King's Tribute healing off every dying minion — she has no Twilight Shroud yet and a softer auto makes her trade miserable. At Level 2 she gains the shroud and the lane flips into a read: inside it she is unselectable, so Chomp and Subjugate will not cast at all. Back off and let it expire rather than swinging blind at the smoke. By Level 3 Five Point Strike into Shuriken Flip lands fast enough that one misstep in the cloud costs a full bar — and her E marks the smoke cloud itself, so she can flip straight back into it. Pillar of Ice is ground-cast and still works in there: place it on her landing spot, not on the smoke.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Akali to deny disengage, or between you and Twilight Shroud to break her pattern.
edits.after: Pillar closes the kit and is ground-cast, so shroud cannot blank it — put it on her Shuriken Flip landing spot to deny re-entry.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside it. Duel when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — unselectable inside it, so Chomp and Subjugate will not cast. - Shuriken Flip: 16s.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside it. Duel when down. When it is down — Pillar + duel her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud (20s) makes her unselectable: Chomp and Subjugate fizzle. Pillar and W are ground-cast, still land.

notes: Killed the fabricated ability 'Three-Talon Strike' (pre-rework Akali) in spikes[1], early and whys[2]. Killed the repeated factual error that Chomp steals ATTACK SPEED — Riot's text says it saps Attack Damage — in spikes[0], wants.you[0], early and whys[0].
